source.prices: Yahoo Finance: unadjusted 15-minute bars, official closes from daily bars

session.note: Oslo-listed series are measured from the official close of the previous session (the closing auction, which 15-minute bars do not contain) to their latest 15-minute bar, and to the official close once the session is over. Brent and USD/NOK trade almost around the clock: their move starts at Oslo's previous close, `change` runs to their own latest bar and `change_oslo` stops at Oslo's latest bar, the same window as the stocks.
